about: What meeting.vtt reads into. The file is written by hand: a header after WEBVTT, a comment block, cue identifiers, times with and without hours, cue settings, voice spans with and without an end tag, a class on a voice tag, a class span, an italics span, a character reference, and one cue's text on two lines.

turns.text: Good morning. Shall we start with the budget?
Yes. Travel is ten percent over plan.
Can we move the offsite to May?
May works, and the venue holds forty people.
Then book it. Research & design present first.
Agreed. I will send the notes today.
